exports.descriptor: gitIdentityDescriptor (id collector.git-identity, readiness ready, owner B02)

input: CollectInput.selectedInput (repo path) or context.worktreePath; else InvalidInput. Non-repo -> SourceUnavailable.
output: EventBatch with one git.context event (acquisition git, origin from input), coverage complete|partial with unavailable:<field> gaps, cursor = upstreamKey
sourceProbe: git 2.56.0 on host (sourceVersion taken from `git --version`); tests exercise real git in temp repos

checks.note: whole-package tsc currently fails on another owner's syntax errors in src/dx/collectors/cursor-local-db/map-rows.ts; none in B02 files

gaps: Base ref is heuristic: origin/HEAD, else first local main/master/trunk/develop; no explicit --base override in CollectInput.
branchCreatedAt comes from the local reflog; unavailable (reported as gap) when reflog is missing/expired or for cloned branches. `git switch -c` records createdFrom=HEAD, not the base name.
firstBranchCommitAt uses author date (rewritable). Commit/numstat detail belongs to B03.
Payload contains absolute local paths (gitDir, worktreePath); fine for the local store, redact before sharing.
Integration (A02/A07) must register gitIdentityCollector; B02 did not touch the barrel/registry.

Process incident: one oxfmt invocation with a mis-expanded file argument may have formatted files outside B02 scope (~14:09 CEST). oxfmt is formatting-only; owners may see 'file changed on disk' notices.
